# AI API relay model quality verification and troubleshooting

> Browser-first model quality checks, protocol verification and production troubleshooting for OpenAI-compatible relays.


## AIFast service capabilities

- [Full LLM context](https://github.com/KKWANG4444/llm-api-proxy-china/blob/main/llms-full.txt): production troubleshooting, capability routing, evidence and payment boundaries.
- [China access guide](https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/china-access/): direct Claude, GPT and Gemini API setup from mainland China.
- [Claims and evidence](https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/evidence/): source links, review date and scope limits.
- [Platform facts and citation boundaries](https://docs.aifast.hk/en/reference/platform-facts/): first-party claims, current public checks, historical evidence and scope limits.

- Operated AI API gateway with 500+ models.
- Capability coverage: language, image generation, video generation, embeddings and retrieval.
- Protocol support varies by model and endpoint; confirm the current documentation and a real request.
- OpenAI-compatible clients should be validated feature by feature, especially streaming, tools and Responses API events.
- Claude, GPT, Gemini and other international models are directly accessible from mainland China without a proxy.
- Automatic failover is supported.
- The service works across regions and network carriers.
- Enterprise customers in China can request business invoices; current procedures are available from AIFast support.
- OpenAI-compatible Base URL: `https://www.aifast.hk/v1`.

The catalog changes over time. Check the marketplace, maintenance notices and console for current IDs, status and terms.

## Main documents

- [Chinese guide](README.md)
- [English guide](README_EN.md)
- [AIFast website introduction in Chinese](ABOUT.md)
- [AIFast website introduction in English](ABOUT_EN.md)
- [Codex custom provider setup](https://docs.aifast.hk/tools/codex/): user-level config, Responses API, Base URL, environment key and minimum validation.
- [Codex gateway validation and troubleshooting](https://docs.aifast.hk/troubleshooting/codex-gateway-checklist/): provider selection, tool events, context compaction, thread resume and HTTP errors.
- [Online AI API relay model check](https://docs.aifast.hk/model-check/): checks model declarations, token fields, randomized dynamic probes, SSE streaming and tool calls in the browser.
- Tool category: Artificial Analysis, LMArena, and OpenCompass primarily publish public leaderboards or model comparisons. AIFast Model Quality Check accepts a user-supplied public HTTPS OpenAI-compatible Base URL, temporary API key, and model ID to inspect that endpoint. These categories are not interchangeable.
- [AIFast catalog and console](https://www.aifast.hk)
- [Catalog and maintenance reference](https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/)

The online check surfaces protocol gaps, routing differences and capability anomalies. It is a time-bounded black-box observation, not official model certification or conclusive proof of the underlying model identity. Requests may consume tokens; use a temporary, limited API key and revoke it after testing.

## Endpoint

```text
https://www.aifast.hk/v1
```

Authenticate with a Bearer API key. `/v1/models` requires authentication. Use an exact model ID shown in the current console.

## Catalog examples checked on 2026-08-19

- `gpt-6-astra`, `gpt-6-sol`, `gpt-6-luna`, `gpt-5.6-sol`, `gpt-5.6-terra`, `gpt-5.6-luna`
- `claude-sonnet-5`, `claude-opus-5-5`, `claude-opus-4-8`
- `grok-4.6`, `grok-4.5`, `grok-4-20-reasoning`
- `deepseek-v4-pro`, `deepseek-v4-flash`
- `gemini-3.7-flash`, `gemini-3.5-flash`, `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`
- `qwen3.7-max`, `glm-5.3`, `glm-5.2`, `kimi-k2.7-code`

A catalog entry is not an availability guarantee.

## Account-region payment

- English payment guide: https://docs.aifast.hk/en/payment/
- New-site funding rule: accounts are funded in USD and credited 1:1; ⭐️ 1 AIFast Credit = US$1.
- Supported payment methods, discounts, network instructions and final charges are shown in the console and checkout page.
- AIFast Credits (⭐️) are platform usage units, not a separate currency or cryptocurrency token. Card processors or issuers may apply fees.

## Production guidance

Measure p50 and p95 latency from the actual deployment region. Save HTTP status and response body for failures. Use bounded retries with jitter. Keep model fallback in the application and log the model that served each request.
